thesis: The 27 Aug U.S. cash session confirmed that NVIDIA's completed FY27 Q2 disclosure and forward outlook could re-open AI and software participation, while the official daily Treasury curve remained higher and Warsh's Jackson Hole remarks were still pending. Hong Kong is a timestamped morning snapshot, not a completed-market confirmation.

prior_thesis_audit.detail: Reuters reported NVIDIA shares rose 8.7% during the 27 Aug U.S. cash session after the FY27 Q2 results and outlook.
Reuters reported semiconductor, Salesforce and CrowdStrike gains, but broader sector participation was mixed; NYSE decliners outnumbered advancers.
Treasury daily par yields rose by 1bp on 27 Aug across the 2Y, 10Y and 30Y tenors versus 26 Aug; the policy interpretation remains conditional on the pending speech.
No independently verified 27 Aug Hong Kong close, turnover or Southbound figure was captured in the present evidence pack.
